Author: The Kinship
Name: Rafter Cat's Chore List
Punchline: A simple to-do list: type your own chores and tick them off.
Description:
A small to-do list window that opens when you log in. Type /chores to open it.

- One list shared by all your characters, plus one list for each character
- Type a chore, press Enter, tick it off when it's done
- Right-click a chore to delete it

It doesn't read or change anything in the game. Your lists are saved on your own PC.
